newsitem.title: HUNGARY: FORECAST - Hungary govt bonds seen steady to lower.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Hungary govt bonds seen steady to lower.

text.p: Government securities yields on Hungary's secondary market were expected to remain steady or ease slightly this week after last week's drops, traders said on Monday.
However, Thursday's three-year government bond auction was seen as an uncertainty factor that could move yields, they added.

"If the demand considerably exceeds the offer (of 10 billion forints) that could bring down yields," said Zsolt Bango of Gog Securities. "If that happens, it could also drag down two and one-and-a-half year papers".
Another trader also said that Thursday's auction was the one to watch but added that he did not expect major surprises.
"The yield would be somewhere between 17.70 and 17.80 percent," said Robert Keszthelyi of Daiwa-MKB Rt.
The average yield of the three-year bonds was 19.19 percent at the previous auction.
He, however, expected somewhat lower yields on the secondary market this week.
